rounds.text: Despite apparent statistical cheapness, Goenka Business & Finance Ltd carries fundamental structural flaws and extreme historical risk that undermine its low valuation multiples [E1, E2]. Long-term top-line erosion is severe, evidenced by compounded sales growth contracting by -14% over 3 years and -3% over 5 years [E10, E9]. Historical profitability has also been chronically depressed, demonstrated by a dismal 10-year median return on equity of just 2% and a sluggish 3-year median ROE of 7% [E20, E22]. Compounded share price performance over the past decade sits at -22%, accompanied by a devastating historical peak-to-trough drawdown of -99.9% [E16, E39]. Governance and stability are further called into question by low promoter ownership standing at only 14.91% [E29], alongside explicit negative flags for a low interest coverage ratio [E49]. Conceded: [E15].
